title: eisa failing with error in Bioconductor-devel
description:
Gábor,

`eisa` is currently failing in Bioconductor devel, http://master.bioconductor.org/checkResults/devel/bioc-LATEST/eisa/zin2-checksrc.html

It looks like an error is being thrown in one of the examples.  Could you look into what is going on and see if you can resolve the issue.

This issue needs to be fixed by April 3rd for the package to be in the next Bioconductor release.
(http://www.bioconductor.org/developers/release-schedule/)

Please let me know if you need any additional assistance in resolving this issue.

Thank you for your time,

Jim Hester (jhester@fredhutch.org)
